# DaQube

> The Data Behind Intelligence. Enterprise human-generated data collection, high-precision annotation, native speech transcription, and AI evaluation services for frontier AI teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **Image Collection**: Global real-world visual datasets across diverse hardware, angles, environments, and ambient lighting.
- **Video Collection**: Multi-angle, high-frame-rate video capture across egocentric, surveillance, and dynamic scenarios.
- **Speech & Audio Collection**: Native acoustic recordings across 1,000+ locales, dialects, accents, and acoustic profiles.
- **Text & Document Data**: OCR extraction, domain-specific text corpora, specialized multilingual normalization.
- **High-Precision Annotation**: 2D/3D bounding boxes, polygon segmentation, keypoint tracking, sensor fusion cuboids.
- **Phonetic Transcription**: Verbatim and normalized speech transcripts with time-stamped speaker diarization.
- **ADAS & LiDAR Annotation**: 3D point cloud segmentation, multi-sensor calibration, autonomous vehicle scenarios.
- **Off-The-Shelf Datasets**: Pre-curated, commercially cleared benchmark datasets for rapid AI model training.

## Compliance & Security
- ISO 27001 certified alignment and ISO/IEC 27001 standards.
- Air-gapped Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) with disabled peripheral ports.
- Cryptographic data erasure upon project completion.
- GDPR and HIPAA BAA compliant data handling workflows.
